subtitles.text: Once we cross it, according to the book, there'll be no way back until we clear every trial. There are no save points inside. Only forward.
Looks like we have to go through all three. I hope at least we can go as a group. I really don't fancy getting separated from you two in there.
I'm not letting either of you out of my sight. Whatever's on the other side.
You're alive. You're alive, you idiot.
Estela? What...?
Where's Will?
Hey. I couldn't leave without saying goodbye properly.
Take care of your brother. Take care of him for me too. And take care of each other.
Thank you, for being my family, even if only for a little while.

Before he destroyed the Path, he used the forbidden spell of resurrection.
That's why you're alive. That's why... he's gone.
Will, what are you doing? Get out of there!
Will! Use your magic, press <sprite name="interactable_x"> and defeat the demon!
How interesting!
The demon's attack has awakened your magic.
Will! Use it against the demon, press <sprite name="interactable_x"> and defeat him.
Will, watch out!
Take that!
What... what was that?
Will, get out of the way!
That's it, Will! You've got this!
Come on, boy! I know you can do it!
Don't give up! Finish it once and for all!
Look at the rune ring around his neck! You can only hurt him while it glows.
Not like that! If the ring isn't glowing, you can't hurt him. Wait for it to light up!
He drops orbs when you hit him! Orange ones heal you, blue ones restore your magic. Grab them!
Dodge his attack and shoot right after: he's worn out and the ring keeps glowing.
Now, Will! The ring is glowing!
It's glowing! Shoot now!
That's it! That's how you hurt him!
That did nothing! Save your magic until the ring glows.
Careful! When he raises his claws or marks the ground, get away, then strike back.
You're hurt! Grab the orange orbs he drops when you hit him.
He's furious! Now he throws fire from afar too: keep moving!
He's desperate! Watch the shadows on the ground: his magic will fall there!
He's almost done! One last push, Will!
Don't waste your magic: wait for the ring to glow.
A stone golem! His front is solid rock: you won't even scratch him.
I'll distract him. When he comes for me, circle round and hit his back!
Hey, pile of rocks, over here! Will, get behind him!
He's after me! Hit him from behind, quick!
He's coming back for you, Will! Hold on, I'll draw him off.
It just bounces off! You can't hurt him from the front.
His back, Will! Aim for his back!
That's it! That one hurt!
Well done! Keep it up!
Watch his rocks! If you see a shadow on the ground, move.
Will, you're hurt! Grab the orange orbs.
Orbs! Orange ones heal, blue ones restore magic.
He's angry! It's going to rain rocks: keep moving!
He's merging with the forest! Watch out when he jumps!

He won't fall! That seal... someone summoned him. Together, Will! Get close and press <kbonly><sprite name="interactable_lt"></kbonly><gpadonly><sprite name="interactable_lt"> and <sprite name="interactable_rt"> together</gpadonly>.
Almost there! Don't let him breathe!
The front is no use. Wait until he comes for me.
This way, Will!
That's for being ugly.
Oh, didn't see that coming?
Poor little thing.
You're sooo boring...

Oh nooo, please... someone help me!
...these two big strong muscular warriors...
...are going to rob a helpless little princess like me...
...Was that it?
Piece of cake!
That fool is going to ruin my plans...
He didn't run.
He stood his ground against the demon. This morning he didn't even know he had magic.
Get up...
He beat it.
It's him. He can open the path.
If only there were another way...
Hold on, Tobi. I'm almost there.
Let's see if this golem is enough...
If not... I'll have to step in myself.
Nobody interrupts me while I'm eating!
RUUUUUN!!!

The first time I cast a spell, I nearly singed my own eyebrows off.
And look at me now... an actual prodigy.
Fear isn't the problem, kiddo.
The problem would be if you stopped trying. And I'm not letting that happen.
Will... what's wrong?

You won't be facing this alone.
Whatever happens.

It's the first time I've ever left home.
My whole life has been back there.
I'm scared, Liam. What if I can't control this?
What if out there, what I am just isn't enough... and it all goes wrong?
...Thank you. Okay. Let's go.
Run! Flee from Estela until her anger blows over!

We need to find out what's behind that demon appearing, and now a golem too...
And why they're after you.
I think I've lost my appetite.
Yes, yes, very insightful. And when is the food coming?
That... wasn't me.
FINALLY!
NOBODY interrupts me when I'm eating!
This guy's going to get it!

Pardon the interruption...
My name is Liam, and I couldn't help overhearing your conversation.
I think I have information that might interest you.
And what it has to do with my magic...
Estela... do you really eat like that?
WHAT?!
Spiders, attack!
Piece of cake? Let's see if our technique is that easy to handle...
Little princess? More like little ugly, don't you think?
Hand over everything you've got and we won't hurt you.
Good grief...
Take care of my brother.

Why do you think you're alive, boy?
Have you never wondered why you remember nothing of yourself, or your past?
I'll tell you why — you remember nothing of yourself, your family, or your village,
because eons ago you died fighting me.
You died that day. You are the reincarnation of the only mage who ever managed to stop me!
You forced me to unleash my ultimate spell of destruction, but back then I couldn't control it.
When it all slipped beyond my grasp, I bound my soul to the Path,
waiting for the day some other fool would clear its trials
and wish me back to life.
To keep the spell from touching your family and your pitiful village,
you poured every last drop of magic inside you into a protective spell —
one that saved your people, but destroyed you.
What I don't understand is how, after dying, you're still here…

Are they still arguing? They’ve been at it for a while...
Before we go and see what’s happening, I wanted to show you something.
Let’s go see what’s going on.
Let's go.
I’ve learned a new spell. Watch.
Wait a moment... I need to catch my breath.
Will! Wait up!
Okay, I like this a lot better.
Here. So you don't forget where you come from.
That's... surprisingly thoughtful.
We should do this more often. Once all this is over, I mean.
Minus the haunted forests. And the candy castles.
No golems, no demons, no—
That's—

It's too much like mine. Like my maze.
I don't think I can go in there, Liam. I'm sorry.
You don't have to be sorry. This trial is mine. It makes sense I face it alone.

Then I'm not going in either. If Will stays, I stay with him. I'm not leaving him out here alone.
But that doesn't mean we're leaving you alone either, understood? We'll be right here, waiting, when you come out.
Thank you. Both of you.
What was the true price you paid to get this far, Mage?
Here... here it is.
Open it. We've come this far.
The ritual to open the Path of the Stars...
Wait. There's more. Two spells noted in the margin, in a different hand... older.

The Time Spell. And... the Resurrection Spell.
Forbidden. There's a note in the margin explaining why.
Whatever that note says... I think we should save this for when we truly need it.
From here on, there's no turning back, is there?
There wasn't from the start. But now... now we truly know it.
Wow, this is actually terrifying.
Don't laugh, it's horrible. I hate speaking in front of people.
A clumsy speech never killed anyone... though I'll admit this one was particularly bad.
It's only an echo. We're right here. Look at us.
I don't deserve you coming to find me. I hurt my own friend.
And Liam? After what he did...
Let's go find him, then. Before this place swallows him whole.
Just so we're clear: this doesn't mean everything's forgiven. It just means I'm not letting him die over feeling guilty.
After what I did...

It was an accident. And I didn't come to judge you.
I came because no one gets left behind. Not even when they mess up.
If we don't forgive him, we're no better than the man who pushed him to do it.
Get up. We're not done yet.
After what you did — and everything you've done since then to try to fix it. That counts too.
Tell me it isn't true. Tell me what we just saw isn't what it looks like.

You planned all of it. The demon in the woods.
The danger. You used Will as bait from day one.
Don't you dare use that as an excuse!
Will... I'm sorry...
My brother is dying. I was desperate. I thought if I could reach the Path...
I don't deserve to be followed.
Both of you, please, stop!

Forbidden Spell: Temporal Regression!
Turn back time... and this time, dodge it.

Your magic, in the moment of your death,
searched through time and space
for a vessel to hold your soul.
Your wish to protect your people, your family,
to end that man's tyranny,
led you to a sick boy
whose heart had just stopped beating,
right as your soul arrived.

You must end the Path.
There is no other way to stop mages like him
from using this place for their own gain, ever again.

You must protect them.
Them, and all of humanity that comes after.
Only then will you truly prove, once and for all, who you really are.

No, Will. You are here, and there.
You are wherever you want to be.
This is only your power, your magic,
the fruit of the good you have done throughout your life.
It's all right, Estela. Don't worry... I've got it all figured out.
Take care of each other. I've already made it home.
Heal his brother. That's the only thing I ask.

Now... now I remember it all.
The protective spell. My parents. My village…
But what am I doing here? How is this possible? And in this body…
You haven’t changed a bit! What are Eldran and Victoria arguing about? I can hear them from here.
Have I gotten my memory back… and I'm dead?
Then I…
Destroy the Path… What about Estela? And Liam?
Where am I?
I love your dancing!
Thanks, master! We'll keep dancing!
Thanks, master! I couldn't have righted it on my own.
Go. I’ll handle him.
I don’t know. Get them to the bridge, quickly.
And when you get back, no more errands. You need a rest.
Come back soon.
Who is he? What does he want?
And you?
As long as I stand, you won’t reach them.
Do you think you can save them all on your own?
You can’t even save yourself.
Come on, Nina! ...Please, be very careful.
Master! My cart’s tipped over again. And I was going slowly this time.
Master! The balloon is stuck at the top of the bell tower.
Whoa, it’s flying!
Look at it go!
It’s going to reach the clouds!
Protect them all!!

I won't take a single step back...
I won't let you touch them! Liora! Nina! Not a single one of them!

Beyond the night and the silence...
Light born before the sky, who laid the path among the stars!

No power of this world can stop him...
So I call upon what does not yet exist! Hear my voice and awaken in my hands!

Let my life be the price and my soul the seal...
No matter what remains of me when the light fades!

Make of my final breath an unbreakable shield!
Burn with me and halt the darkness!
Forgive me, Liora... I'm not coming home.
Let this valley never have existed.
Let the void devour you!
To the bridge! All of you, now!
Carefully... That’s it.
Oops! Sorry, it got away from me.
Good morning, village. What needs fixing today?
I meant to answer today. But something always comes up in the valley.
Have you decided what to tell the academy? You’ve had that letter for weeks.
You don’t have to stay just because they need you here. What do you want?
Two crates, Victoria. I carried them myself, one on top of the other.
Well, only one made it here. Did you stop on the way?
Only for a moment... to rest in the shade of a tree.
Then that’s where it’ll be. Go on, say hello to Will, he’s been waiting a while.
Will! Look at me, losing crates at my age. It’ll turn up.
Victoria, you haven’t seen the other crate of apples, have you?
What other crate? You only brought one this morning.
I could have sworn there were two. My back hurt twice as much!
Here they go again... I’d better see what’s going on.
Need a hand?
Yes, please. Help me stack the fruit before you two go.
Together, like we agreed. No matter what.
Now, don't let him get up!
His crystals protect him! If they fall, he falls.
That's it, Will!
Will! Are you okay?
Hang in there, Will! I'm not leaving you alone.
He's lifting the whole ground!
His crystals first, Will.
No one crosses the tide.
We haven't done anything to him...
With me! Now!
Hold <sprite name="interactable_b">
There's no gap at all... Ten seconds. Only once.
<sprite name="interactable_confirm">
Enough... enough. You win.
It's over! We've got him!
Fools.
LIAM!
Time, again! Press <sprite name="interactable_confirm">.
Nothing... The well is dry.
Will. The conduit.
How much can you give me?
Everything I have left. I'm giving it to you.
Hold <sprite name="interactable_lt"> and <sprite name="interactable_rt"> to receive Estela's energy.
Press <sprite name="interactable_confirm"> to fire the needle of light at the conduit.
No... my wish... the altar...
Good morning, master!
Morning, master!
Hey, master, look! Come dance with us!
Tonight we dance it in front of the whole village!
A small flame. Just the wick...
Well. Not a spark too many.
Promising... if what you want is to declare war on your clothes.
The baker gave it to me. For the village mage. But bringing it here was my idea.
Did you buy it for me?
And I'm sorry about the forest. I shouldn't have sent you alone.
Yeah, but when I threw the fire at it... It was this big. No, bigger. This big.
Hey, you saw the whole thing yesterday, right?
Of course. I was helping you.
Last night, when you told me, it was half that.
Have I always been able to do this?
I don't know. There's something about the night I found you that I never told you.
You know I found you in an overturned cart, by the road.
It was so dark you couldn’t see a thing. I only found you because there was a light.
The woman with you had a little flame burning between her fingers, so someone would see you.
She was still breathing. I never found out who she was.
She only had time to ask me not to leave you alone. Then the flame went out.
I promised her.
And you? What do you know about magic?
Again? We’ve talked about this a thousand times.
No. A thousand times you’ve changed the subject.
Forty years ago I went with some friends looking for something we shouldn't have.
We all came back but one.
What were you looking for?
Another day.
This is what the demon wore around its neck. I brought it back from the forest and buried it in salt.
What if another one shows up? Next time it might not be me in the forest. It might be some kid from the village.
That’s why you need someone who really knows. I can’t teach you, and nobody here can read these runes.
There’s a sorceress in the Forbidden Forest. Her name is Estela.
They say she’s very powerful and, according to half the stories, impossible to put up with.
And according to the other half?
Same. But if anyone can teach you not to set yourself on fire every time you sneeze, it’s her.
I'll go.
I know. But not like this: get ready first.
Take a piece of the collar. Let her see it.
And who is this guy?

Someone with a great deal of patience.
I've waited centuries for someone to arrive here with an unspent wish. I didn't expect three children.

It's him. The one from my nightmare.
The Dark Mage.

The Dark Mage?
Is that what you call me out there?
The wish is for my brother.

I already used mine. It keeps me alive, but binds me to this stone.
Yours will set me free.

You should understand better than anyone, boy.
Have you never wondered why you remember nothing before that old man found you? Not a face, not a home?
Where am I? Am I dead?
No. You are with me.
He knows something about me... something I don't.

A long time ago, a man stayed behind in a valley to hold off the Dark Mage while people crossed a bridge.
Centuries later, he found a child whose heart had just stopped. He made it beat again and stayed with him.
It was you... Then am I you?

No. We are two souls.
I've lived with you ever since, nothing more. Your years, your people, and your mistakes are yours.
I'm afraid. You lost.

I sealed him alone. That was my mistake.
I thought I had to carry everything by myself.
I am not alone.

No. You never have been. That is why this time can be different.
You can create spells the way anything is created: by wanting it with all your strength.
Go back to them. They are waiting for you.
Hey, idiot... Are you okay?
Yes... I'm here.

Now you know.
Then you will remember me.
I remember everything.
Everything? What is he talking about?

It's a long story. I'll tell you later.
Everything, I promise.

You'd better.
We already have one in the group who keeps secrets.
This time, I didn't come alone.
What are you doing?! Get out of there!
Take care of Tobias.

No! You take care of him!
Will, get out of there right now!

You have to give it back to me!
When we get out! You promised!

I know.
Idiot... I will never forget you.
No... no...
WIIIIILL!!
Estela...? What...?

You're alive...
You're alive.
Where is Will?

He pushed me out. He stayed inside with you...
And now you are here, and he isn't.
That idiot...
Idiot? Is that what you... really look like?

I am sorry.
I am not Will.
Then who are you?

Someone who lived inside him since he was a child.
He was going to tell you. He promised.

He wrote on a list that he wanted to return alive.
I wanted that once too, long ago. I couldn't.
And what does that mean?

I have no one left out there.
Mine have been waiting for me for centuries. Thank you for finishing what I left undone. Now I can join them.
I think this ribbon belongs to someone.

Give it back when we get out, you said.
Well, we are out.
Will...?
WILL!!
How...? The spell...?

He brought me back.
It was the last thing he did before leaving.
Idiot... Don't you dare do something like that again.
Promised.
A few weeks later…
I don't know how to fish.

Neither do I.
That's why we're going to learn.

Look, Will! I drew you while you were away…
Well, I didn't really know you yet.
I guess so.
Then hold still, so I can draw your face.

A bite!
Something huge is biting!
Uh-oh...
WILL!!
Did they tell you about the syrup?
NO!!

See, Tobi: there was this huge party, with a syrup fountain thiiis big. And Will, running around, tripped… and got all wrapped up in the tablecloth like a bride!
He rolled and rolled… and landed right on top of Liam. Right under a sign that said 'I LOVE YOU!'!
Did you get married?
No!
Almost.

Look...
My star stayed up there.
Huh? Where's my star...?
He kept it...
What star?
A wooden one I bought in the village market, before all this. It was carved so badly it wasn't good for anything.

He traded it for a life.
You come out winning.
Again... Again, Liam.
Just one more, it's getting late.
It all started with a fruit crate…
Eldran had left it in the forest, under a tree, and I was the one who had to go and get it.
And there, in the middle of the forest, something happened to me that I still can't believe.
...and from that day on, nothing was ever the same.
Above their heads, among thousands of stars, one shone a little brighter than the rest.
The End
I wish for his brother to live.
The formula from the Ancient Stone... I haven't forgotten a single line.

"You who keep the breath where the stars are born...
let no threshold close upon one still called by name."

"A life for a life. My pulse for his pulse.
Let my light cross the gate and his burn once more!"
GO BACK TO THEM, LIAM!!
Move!

—That's not what happened! I slipped on the syrup!
—No, no, no! I was just walking by!
See, Tobi: there was this huge party, with a syrup fountain thiiis big.
And Will, running around, tripped… and got all wrapped up in the tablecloth like a bride!

He rolled and rolled… and landed right on top of Liam.
Right under a sign that said 'I LOVE YOU!'!
Is it… really you?
Thanks, Tobi! I love it.
Ooh, so handsome, Will!
Tobías, draw Estela.
Blah blah blah…
